create_wolf_phc_agent: create a WoLF-PHC reinforcement learning agent for multi-player game environments
build_wolf_schedule: build a WoLF schedule that decays step size using t0 / (t + t1) over training steps
run_wolf_phc_step: run the WoLF-PHC agent step to select actions and update Q-values during training
test_hill_climbing_update: test the hill-climbing policy update that shifts probability mass toward greedy actions
review_wolf_phc_loss: review the WoLF-PHC agent loss property that returns the last TD error value
